messages:
leo_csm: FYI NovaSupply onboarding slowed to a crawl. Week2 activation metrics at 48% of target, trial license seats only half-used. Renewal ~35d. I'm proposing a short 'activation sprint' play: 10-day enablement blitz + targeted docs + downgrade-buffer offer if activation doesn't improve. Thoughts?
anya_csm: agree we need a fast, measurable plan. Prefer conditional incentives vs blanket discounts. what success metric do we tie to the sprint?
leo_csm: target = 12 active API calls/day per seat for 7/10 days OR 75% seat claim. If hit, credit voids; if miss, offer downgrade-buffer (50% seats for 30d) + extended support for 60d.
sam_success_eng: We can run 3 quick enablement touchpoints: 1) API walkthrough (30m), 2) integration checklist run-through (15m), 3) post-integration smoke test. I can own the smoke test.
kai_product: Recommend we unlock a "starter-mode" workspace for them: hides advanced connectors, pre-populates sample flows. Lowers friction. We can flip a tenant flag for them for 14 days.
leo_csm: Good. I'll draft the customer message and include the proposed KPI and dates. Use template /templates/activation-sprint-email.md and cc @anya.
playbookbot: Creating play nova-activation-sprint-v1. Tasks: schedule API walkthrough -> unassigned; enable starter-mode -> unassigned; run smoke test -> unassigned; attach activation dashboard -> unassigned. Play link: https://ops.redwood/plays/nova-activation-sprint-v1
anya_csm: KPI wording: "12 API calls/day per seat for 7 out of 10 consecutive days". Also add a softer fallback: 20% usage credit if they hit 5/10 days.
sam_success_eng: smoke test snippet for the play: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/run -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'` expect 200 and non-empty choices[0].text. If latency >200ms or error -> escalate to eng-oncall.
leo_csm: I'll send the offer now. If they accept sprint, we'll enable starter-mode and schedule the walkthrough within 48h. If they decline, we trigger downgrade-buffer play and coordinate sales for renewal conversation.
kai_product: I'll prepare the starter-mode flip and a short 'how to' doc to link.
leo_csm: thanks team. posting status updates to #customer-health-nova. closing thread, will reopen if customer pushes back.
